{{Vanilla|Furnace}}
{{Infobox auto}}
An '''oven''' is a block used to cook [[food]]. It replaces the {{MCW|Furnace|furnace}} and works like one, with fuel, but it only cooks food and a few plants and blocks: ores need a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]]. It cooks food twice as fast as a vanilla furnace and is the only station that makes [[Pumpkin Curry|pumpkin curry]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The oven needs 3 iron ingots, 4 blocks of bricks and a [[kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/oven.json}}</ref> The vanilla furnace recipe is removed. Crafting one grants the advancement ''Now You're Cooking''.

== Usage ==
=== Cooking food ===
{{Main|Cooking}}
The oven cooks every food that [[kindling]] can, plus a few that only it can:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/pumpkin_curry.json}}</ref>
* All simple preparations of [[intrinsic]] ingredients, such as [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]], [[Steamed Carrots|steamed carrots]] and [[chocolate]].
* [[Bread]] from [[dough]], [[Baked Potato|baked potato]]es, [[Fried Egg|fried egg]]s, [[nopales]] and cooked meat and [[Fish|fish]].
* [[Molasses]] from sugar cane.
* [[Popped Chorus Fruit|Popped chorus fruit]] and [[Dried Kelp|dried kelp]], which only the oven makes.
* The oven meals: [[Green Curry|green curry]], [[Japanese Curry|Japanese curry]], [[Paneer Makhani|paneer makhani]], [[Tonkotsu Ramen|tonkotsu ramen]] and [[Pumpkin Curry|pumpkin curry]], cooked from their [[stock]]s. Pumpkin curry can only be cooked in an oven.

Food takes 5 seconds and the oven meals 15 seconds. Each item gives 0.35 experience, except molasses (0.01).

=== Other smelting ===
{{Data/Station/Oven}}
The vanilla recipes marked in the table still work.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/oven/cobblestone_from_mossy_cobblestone.json}}</ref> Copper, ancient debris, stone and most other vanilla smelting recipes are removed; they moved to the [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] or the blast furnace.

== Advancements ==
* ''Now You're Cooking'': construct an oven from bricks and iron.
